interpretation_notes: The proposed system is represented by the frozen Integrated (full) predictions, produced with finalizer prompt v4_1 and without subtopics. Chapter-Llama predictions come from a single fixed run, and the ground truth is the fixed 20-program annotation set.
Matched IoU is a conditional mean over matched segments only; always report it together with segment precision, recall, and F1.
One-to-one IoU matching maximizes the number of pairs at or above the threshold and, only when tied, maximizes the total IoU.
The editorial-mask analysis is a diagnostic sensitivity analysis that uses the ground truth; it is not used for the main results or for boundary accuracy.

The frozen predictions use the original TS recordings as input, whereas Chapter-Llama uses MP4 files verified to be aligned with them. The comparison is therefore a system-level comparison, not a same-component ablation.
